text: Ortial ferer has not any mark to direct him: hence after- momers are obliged to enlighten the crois-hairs artifi, in order to render them vifible, and this with- out letting the luminous body interfere with the ob- jefe which they intend to view , and, for doing this, two ways are propofel.
